title: How to split groceries with roommates
description: Split groceries with roommates fairly: even split, by item, or shared staples, with tax shared by what each person bought. A worked example and a free tool.
lead: Splitting groceries sounds simple until one person buys oat milk nobody else touches. Here is how to keep it fair without keeping a spreadsheet.

title: How to split rent fairly between roommates
description: Split rent fairly when the rooms are different sizes: equal, by room size, or by shares. A worked example with a $2,400 rent and what to do about utilities.
lead: Equal rent is easy. Fair rent is a conversation. These are the common ways to split it, with the maths.

title: How to split a restaurant bill with tax and tip
description: Split a restaurant bill fairly, including tax and tip, when people ordered different amounts and shared appetizers. A worked example with real numbers.
lead: Splitting the check evenly is quick, but it is not fair when people ordered very differently. Here is how to do it properly, tax and tip included.

title: How to split utilities with roommates
description: Split utilities fairly when roommates use different amounts or move in mid-month: equal, by shares, or by days. A worked example with real numbers.
lead: Internet is shared equally; the electric bill is not. Here is how to split each fairly, including the awkward partial month.

title: How to split costs on a group trip
description: Split group trip costs fairly when different people pay for different things: set rules first, track as you go, and settle with the fewest payments.
lead: One person books the lodging, another pays for gas, a third buys the snacks. Here is how to even it all out without an argument.

title: How to split expenses as a couple
description: Ways couples split shared costs: 50/50, in proportion to income, by category, or with a joint account, with a worked example of what each does.
lead: Splitting rent and groceries is easy. Splitting them fairly when incomes differ takes a decision. Here are the options and what each one does.

title: Splitwise alternatives: what to look for
description: A checklist for choosing a bill-splitting app: no forced sign-ups, item-level splits, fair tax and tip, exact maths, clear balances and privacy.
lead: Comparing bill-splitting apps? These are the questions worth asking, and how Settled answers them, including what it does not do.
